name: Hazure Onna
source: A Hazure Onna type monster girl. Hazure Onna means failure woman and this Hazure Onna is ugly and terrifying. [url=http://vndb.org/c13605]Kira[/url] warns [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] to avoid her at all cost. She will force herself into Leo's party, is a terrible warrior, and spends most of the time screaming. She's best avoided.
